accepted.quote: redefining ``firearm'' to exclude less-than-lethal projectile devices from background check requirements is of grave concern for public safety.
accepted.bill: Innovate Less Lethal to De-Escalate Tax Modernization Act
accepted.rationale: Opposes excluding less-than-lethal projectile devices from background checks as a public-safety risk.

accepted.quote: While we support good faith efforts to aid law enforcement with reducing the use of lethal force, this bill does not move towards that goal.
accepted.bill: Innovate Less Lethal to De-Escalate Tax Modernization Act
accepted.rationale: Expresses support for good-faith efforts to aid law enforcement in reducing use of lethal force.
